text:
Maya: Pushed PR #8345 to refresh the quickstart hello-world. Main changes: swap long-lived keys for ephemeral tokens, add a tiny Docker HEALTHCHECK, and include a one-line "run-in-30s" example. Short goal: lower friction for trying the API.
Ethan: Nice. Which ephemeral approach are we showing? CLI or curl?
Maya: Showing both. CLI example: `redwood auth ephemeral --ttl 300` then `export RW_EPHEM=$(redwood auth ephemeral)`; curl example also included: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_EPHEM" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`
Rina: Can we add a Docker-Compose snippet for folks who want to run the sample app locally with env passthrough? I can add it if you want.
Maya: Please do, Rina. A single `environment:` block and `HEALTHCHECK CMD curl -fsS http://app:8080/health || exit 1` should be enough.
Kai: CI found a redundant `sudo` in the Dockerfile and a small shellcheck warning in the entrypoint. Pushed a fix branch commit.
Ethan: doc-bot, run link-checker and image-checker on the branch?
doc-bot: link-checker started for branch quickstart/ephemeral -> 10 links scanned, 1 broken (external blog image). image-checker flagged 1 404.
Maya: I removed the external blog image and replaced it with a tiny inline SVG markup snippet and an alt-text note. Also removed the outbound link.
Rina: Added the docker-compose example and a short note about mapping ports for the quicktest. Also added a tiny troubleshooting tip for corporate proxies (increase curl timeout).
QA: Can we add the following to the PR checklist before merging? 1) docker build, 2) docker run with HEALTHCHECK observed, 3) quick ephemeral token created and used in a sample request, 4) verify example returns 200 and sample JSON. I can take this.
Maya: Added the checklist and labeled PR QA-needed. Pinged @QA.
Kai: Ran local docker build and healthcheck on linux. Entrypoint lint fixed the subtle race with the token file. All good.
Ethan: Did a content read: reworded one paragraph for clarity and fixed two code fences. Left tiny inline comments.
Maya: Addressed comments and squashed the lint commit. Re-requested reviews.
doc-bot: CI: docs-lint passed, link-checker passed, docker-build passed, spellcheck noted 1 US/UK variant.
QA: Smoke test complete ✅ build OK, container reports healthy, ephemeral token sample request returns 200 and expected body.
Rina: Thanks — I also added a note in the quickstart about ephemeral tokens expiring and how to refresh them programmatically.
Maya: Great. Unless anyone objects, I'll merge after final CI wrap.
Ethan: LGTM once CI finishes.
Kai: Docker signoff from infra.
Maya: Merging now — thanks everyone. If there are follow-ups (extra language examples or GIFs), please open new PRs and tag me.
doc-bot: Merged by Maya into main (PR #8345).
